I saved this as a project convention in EngramDB, so future sessions in ledgerline will see it: all background jobs go through `jobs.enqueue()`, and nothing calls Celery directly (no `.delay()`, `.apply_async()` or `send_task`). There wasn't an existing memory about this to conflict with.

I searched the repo and found no `enqueue` function and no Celery usage yet, so there's no existing code to update. The rule applies to new code from here on.
